'''Rollo''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] living during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. In [[3643 BBY]] he was stationed on [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]], where he was sent by [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Bessiker]] to assist a [[Darth Nox|Sith]] in apprehending a defector scientist [[Iannos Tyrek]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Captain Rollo appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' during the Sith Inquisitor class mission on Balmorra.
